Bilateral pedal oedema may be due to the decrease in the levels of albumin (long standing cirrhosis).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe ulcerations are due to limited movements (improper dressings).\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E3) What was the reason for his asterixis and constructional apraxia and what was done by the treating team to address that? \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003EAns. Asterixis is a clinical sign that describes the inability to maintain sustained posture with subsequent brief, shock like, involuntary movements. This sign is not pathognomonic for any condition.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe was given Lactulose and Rifamixin.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\" style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: large;\"\u003E4) What was the efficacy of each treatment intervention used for this patient? Air or water bed to prevent pressure bed sores in the dependent areas\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EC. Fluid restriction \u0026lt;1.5litres\/day so as to decrease of fluid dissemination into the extra vascular space\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003ED. Salt restriction \u0026lt;2.4gms\/day to prevent retention of water.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv dir=\"auto\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #222222; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: medium;\"\u003EE. text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere's a case that I saw of a 22 year old with Pedal Oedema and Shortness of Breath-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA young daily wage labourer presented with complaints of bilateral lower limb swelling from past 1 month, patient also had complaints of shortness of breath on exertion since 20 days which progressed to SOB at rest from the last 5 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor these complaints pt was taken to a nearby hospital and started on medication (no documentation) which he eventually stopped after 3 days claiming no health issue can happen to him. Patient had resumed his daily activities later on inspite of edema occurring intermittently. 8 days back patient was struck by grief after his grandfather expired and patient binged on alcohol the entire evening.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe developed pain abdomen the next morning which was maximum in intensity in the epigastric region. Patient also informs the nauseous feeling developed since then.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe complaints of reduced urine output in the past 4 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWhen he came to the hospital he had tachypnea and his bp was 80\/50 mm hg for which we have started lasix but it kept dropping,so was started on nor adrenaline after which his blood pressure was stabilised.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast History-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo similar complaints in the past.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case of Diabetes Mellitus, Hypertension, Asthma, Epilepsy, Tuberculosis, Cardiac or Thyroid Abnormalities.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFamily History-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo similar complaints in the family.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal History-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMixed diet.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENormal Appetite.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAdequate Sleep.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERegular Bowel and Bladder movements.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions-\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is an alcoholic and is consuming toddy of about 1 litre,hooch of about 1 litre,180 ml of whisky on daily basis for the past 11 years.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral Examination-\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent, cooperative.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EModerately built, Moderately nourished.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
